description.en: A list of mount point details

description.zh: 已挂载HDFS文件系统的ECS实例ID。
description.en: The ECS instance ID for the instance that has an HDFS file system mounted.

description.zh: VSC ID，InstanceId与VscId只能设置一个，且必须设置一个
description.en: The VSC ID. Set either InstanceId or VscId, but not both.
A custom name for the VSC.

description.zh:
VSC类型。
取值： 
- Primary（默认值）：ECS实例上的预留默认VSC
- Secondary：ECS实例上的可重复VSC
description.en:
The VSC type. Valid values:

- Primary (default): A reserved default VSC on an ECS instance.

- Secondary: A reusable VSC on an ECS instance.

description.zh:
是否使用扮演者检验计算节点权限。

- true：是
- false（默认值）：否
description.en:
Whether to use role assumption to check compute node permissions. Valid values:

- true

- false (default)

descriptions.zh: 目前仅支持 1 个 Vsc 关联到多个 MountPoint，即 AttachInfos.InstanceId 或 AttachInfos.VscId 需相等
descriptions.en: You can attach a single VSC to multiple mount targets. The InstanceId or VscId values in AttachInfos must be identical.
